what_happened: Layout 9 (side-by-side fridge, narrow open right compartment), wide black bowl_5, carrot, drumstick 013. Stage 0: carrot grasped 94, released in the bowl 160 (stage 0 at 160). Stage 1: drumstick grasped 284, released in the bowl 379 (stage 1 at 385, normal). Stage 2: rim grasp 428-448 (width 0.015), lift 0.574 m. The bowl tilted past 45 deg at 609 and was carried that way. At the fridge (700-850) the arm raised it to the top of the compartment opening, at the top shelf (yellow bottle distractor). The fingers loosened 744-808 (0.014 -> 0.030), and the drumstick slid out over the rim at ~800-810 and fell to the floor (drop 1.27 m). At 816-824 the gripper opened fully, but the bowl was not on a shelf: it stayed balanced on the open hand. As the arm swung down and out of the fridge (852-912), it carried the bowl along, and at ~917 the bowl, with the carrot, fell off the hand to the floor 0.59 m outside the fridge interior. The arm then stayed near the fridge until the timeout.
causal_chain: bowl tilted > 45 deg in the rim grasp from 609 -> raised to the top of the narrow compartment at the fridge -> drumstick spilled at ~805 (stage 1 undone) -> gripper opened at ~820 with the bowl not on a shelf, the bowl resting on the open hand -> arm withdrew and the bowl fell to the floor at ~917 -> all stages lost
official_criterion_notes: The bowl's hold 436-917 includes ~95 steps after the fingers opened (816-917), with the bowl resting on the open hand; release_step 917 marks when it fell off the hand, not when the fingers opened.
